steps.title: Open the jack and seat the pairs
steps.action: Take the faceplate off the office box and push each coloured wire pair into the matching slot on the keystone jack (the snap-in socket the cable plugs into).
do_not_touch: the other cables in the box
steps.stop_condition: if any wire is warm, scorched or smells burnt, stop and contact a human
steps.evidence_required: the wall jack open with the faceplate off and the coloured wire pairs terminated into the keystone module

steps.title: Test the link
steps.action: Plug the cable tester into both ends and read the lights.
steps.evidence_required: the tester showing all eight lights in order

0.reason: The faceplate is off the wall box and the keystone jack is clearly visible with the coloured wire pairs (blue, orange, green) seated into the module's IDC slots.

evidence_boxes.label: keystone jack with wire pairs terminated
